tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub thabs nges don thig le bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra kī la ya/ 'od gsal dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i sku/ /bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu la/ /btud nas de yi sgrub thabs 'bri/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yi/ /sgrub thabs shin tu bsdus pa ni/ /'khrul zad sngags 'chang yab sras kyis/ /phyag len mdzad pa 'di ltar ro/ /sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum/ /sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal dag dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba at+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ rdo rje khro bos zhe sdang gcod/ /mtshon chen sngon po cher 'bar ba/ /nam mkha'i dkyil du thig le shar/ /srog gi sgo ru shar ba dang / /snying gi dkyil du bsgoms par bya/ hūm̐ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las raṃ chad snod bcud kyi 'jig rten bsregs/ yaṃ spros pa rlung gis gtor/ khaṃ spros pas chus bkrus/ skyon thams cad dag par byas/ e yaṃ waṃ raṃ laṃ raṃ keṃ e s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las yi ge de dag spros pas rten gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ e las mkha' dbyings dag pa nam mkha'i dkyil/ /yaṃ las rlung chen rgya gram sra zhing brtan/ /de steng waṃ las byung ba'i chu dkyil dkar/ /raṃ las me byung bskyed pa de yi phyed/ /laṃ las sa yi dkyil 'khor brtan par gyur/ /de steng rak+ta'i rgya mtsho'i rba klong 'khrugs/ /dbus su keṃ rus ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng / /gru gsum mthing nag mu khyud rdo rjes spras/ /dzaḥpad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ ma hā de wa dzaḥ u ma de wi dzaḥ rgyu yi ting nge 'dzin gyi hūm̐ de dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du babs pa las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus/ 'od du zhu nas rang rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gyur pa ni/

hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ saṃ ha na ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ gdan steng bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga dang / /me dpung 'bar ba rtse gsum bsnams/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis gnyis phyag gis bsnams/ /mtha' gnyis phur 'dril sku che rag /mche gtsigs spyan gsum zlum zhing dmar/ /ral pa kham pa gyen du brdzes/ /glang lpags zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol/ /stag gi pags pa'i 'og pags can/ /dkar dmar ljang nag sbrul gyis brgyan/ /dbu rgyan se ral sked chings dang / /phyag dang zhabs rnams rnam par spras/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /rlon pa lnga bcu'i dol shal can/ /rak+ta zhag dang thal chen kyis/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/ /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs nas/ /dbang phyug kha bub mgo bo dang / /u ma'i nu ma rab tu brdzis/ /ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched/ skra nyi khri chig stong / ba spu bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi la sogs pa thams cad kyang rdo rje gzhon nu rang dang 'dra bas go mtshams med par gtams par gyur/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ /bcad cing mnan pa nyid min te/ /phung po rdo rje'i bdag nyid de/ /rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ /bh+rūṃ bi mā na mā sur+ya hūm̐ dz+nyā na satwa kriṣ+ṇa shu ka pañtsa badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nan bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ dīp+ta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sngo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stobs/ /gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ /rus pa'i rgyan lngas sku la spras/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas/

/sbrul dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /rak+ta zhag dang thal chen gyis/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas g.yon brkyang bskum gyis/ /yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs/ /rdo rje gzhon nu rig 'dzin rnams/ /'khor ba rdo rjes bsgrub par mdzod/ /oṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ 'khor ba rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ /ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra sa ma dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi ṇi hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra bhai ra we hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta hūm̐ baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mā ra ṇi hūm̐ ho/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /rdo rje de nyid rang bzhin las/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid/ /'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa/ /sku yi gter du bdag bskyed cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gsungs/ /rdo rje de nyid༞ /chos kyi༞ /'bar ba'i༞ /gsung gi༞ /thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ wak+ka badz+ra༞ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes thugs/ /rdo rje de nyid༞ /chos kyi༞ /'bar ba'i༞ /thugs kyi༞ /tsit+ta badz+ra༞ thabs kyi spyod pa'i sems cad don/ /byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba/ /sangs rgyas 'phrin las rdzogs par mdzod/ /dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig /oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka badz+ra kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha shrī he ru ka bud+dha kro tī shwa ri oṃ/ oṃ rat+na shrī he ru ka rat+na kro ti shwa ri traṃ/ oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka pad+ma kro dhi shwa ri hrī/ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro ti shwa ri āḥ hūm̐ badz+ra dz+nyā na kī li kī la ya dz+nyā na sa twa e tri ko na bi ma na/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍal la/ a tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍa la/ hūm̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bhigh+nan bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang phyug u ma bsnol ba'i gdan steng nas/ /bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu ni/

/sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /yab yum thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med/ /'khor gyi phra men pho nya'i tshogs la sogs/ /yun ring dus nas bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i lha/ /drag po rang byung dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nan bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ji ltar rigs pa'i mthar/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang / tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas nas/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang nyid bkrag mdangs gzi brjid nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ lha tshogs 'khor bcas ma lus kun/ /sngon gyi thugs dam dgyes dgongs la/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang / /kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol/ /ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga bde bar gshegs/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi/ /'khor lo rab bskor zhi khro'i skur ston pa/ /thugs dam dbang gis bdag la brtser dgongs nas/ /drag po'i stobs kyis dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /he ru ka'i yig brgya tshar gsum/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku ma ra kro dha rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ka wa tse hūm̐ phaṭa/ dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can kun/ /bdud las rnam rgyal bar chad kun bcom nas/ /rdo rje gzhon nu mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /'bras bu byang chub nges par 'grub gyur cig

/skyes med chos sku'i rang bzhin rnam dag las/ /thugs dam dbang gi gzugs kyi skur sprul pa/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi/ /skye shi med pa don gyi bkra shis shog /ces dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub thabs shin tu bsdus pa sa lo sngags 'chang yab sras kyi dgongs pa 'khrul med 'di ni sa skya kun blos yon tan rgya mtsho'i don du bris pa dge/ //maṅga laṃ/ /zhus so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub thabs nges don thig le/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
